achievements.name: Friend Heart
achievements.detail: Throw a Friend Heart so an enemy joins Kirby in a stage.

achievements.name: Whispy Woods
achievements.detail: Defeat Whispy Woods in Fruity Forest.

achievements.name: Dedede Match
achievements.detail: Defeat King Dedede and break the heart that has him attacking.

achievements.name: Friend Star
achievements.detail: Join your allies into the Friend Star and fly through that part of a stage.

achievements.name: Dream Friend
achievements.detail: Call an unlocked Dream Friend from a Dream Palace and bring them into a stage.

achievements.name: Mage-Sisters
achievements.detail: Defeat Francisca, Flamberge, and Zan Partizanne in the fortress.

achievements.name: Fortress of Shadows
achievements.detail: Clear the Fortress of Shadows and finish that world.

achievements.name: Guest Star
achievements.detail: Finish one Guest Star route with an ally leading the party.

achievements.name: Ultimate Choice
achievements.detail: Clear The Ultimate Choice on any difficulty.

achievements.name: Soul Melter
achievements.detail: Clear The Ultimate Choice on the Soul Melter difficulty.

achievements.name: Story's End
achievements.detail: Win the last battle of Story Mode.
